# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2017

**An Ordinance Creating the "Pitogo Voluntary Blood Donation Council" (PVBDC)**

## Summary

Creates the [[Pitogo Voluntary Blood Donation Council (PVBDC)]] to advance advocacy for voluntary blood donation in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. The council ensures a steady, available, and safe supply of blood through voluntary donation, particularly for urgent needs during disasters, calamities, emergencies, and for needy or indigent patients.

Absent during session: [[Carlos T. Gliane II]].

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1 (Title):** Pitogo Voluntary Blood Donation Council (PVBDC)
- **Section 2 (Objective):** Ensuring a steady, available, and safe supply of blood through voluntary donation; addresses urgent needs during disasters, calamities, emergencies, and for needy/indigent patients
- **Section 3 (Creation):** Composed of **70%** from SB-accredited NGOs, POs, and Private Sector; **30%** from government
- **Section 4 (Composition):**
  - Honorary Chairman: Municipal Mayor
  - Chairman: Elected by NGOs/POs/Private Sector
  - Vice-Chairman: Elected
  - Members: Municipal Health Officer and others

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]

- [[Carlos T. Gliane II]] — absent
